n: Network Investment Program (NIP) Australian Rail Track Corporation (ARTC) Track Network Upgrades
ag: Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts
agencies: Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts

grants.n: This grant will provide $150 million in Australian Government funding to the ARTC Track Rehabilitation and Operational Upgrades Project. It forms part of ARTC's $540 million NIP which will support improvements to the interstate rail freight network.

This grant will provide $150 million in Australian Government funding to the Replacement of Sleepers - Maroona to Portland Project. It forms part of ARTC's $540 million NIP which will support improvements to the interstate rail freight network.

This grant will provide $140 million in Australian Government funding to the Culvert Upgrades Project. This project is part of the ARTC's $540 million Network Investment Program which will support improvements to the interstate rail freight network.

This grant will provide $100 million in Australian Government funding to the ARTC Re-railing Package Project. It forms part of ARTC's $540 million NIP which will support improvements to the interstate rail freight network.
